Method of Attack: Steals Discord user tokens and browser information from Google Chrome, Brave Browser, Opera, and Yandex Browser by accessing LevelDB databases in user data folders
Sends collected information via a Discord webhook to an attacker-controlled Discord channel
Automatically starts executables named 'bd.exe', 'dropper.exe', and 'lib.exe' when launched (for discord.app, dropper.exe is launched)
Attack Vector: Malicious NPM packages uploaded to the public NPM registry, exploiting the open system and typosquatting to trick developers into installing them
Indicators of Compromise: Discord user tokens from Discord, Discord PTB, and Discord Canary
Victim's public IP address via https://api.ipify.org/?format=json
Discord webhook used to exfiltrate data
Executables named 'bd.exe', 'dropper.exe', and 'lib.exe' launched by some packages
